span.label: The towers variant improves scalability but is still insufficient for much larger graphs.
span.note: what this limits: the scalability claim: THE TOWERS VARIATION MAKES THESE MODELS MORE SCALABLE, BUT ADDITIONAL IMPROVEMENTS WILL BE NEEDED TO SCALE TO MUCH LARGER GRAPHS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Generalising to larger molecules is hard precisely when spatial information is used.
span.note: what this limits: the spatial-information variants specifically: GENERALIZING TO LARGER MOLECULE SIZES SEEMS PARTICULARLY CHALLENGING WHEN USING SPATIAL INFORMATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Combining the towers variant with the edge-network message function did not work.
span.note: what this limits: the towers-plus-edge-network combination: UNFORTUNATELY, OUR ATTEMPTS SO FAR AT COMBINING THE TOWERS AND EDGE NETWORK MESSAGE FUNCTION HAVE FAILED TO FURTHER IMPROVE PERFORMANCE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Some ablation experiments used a partial-charge input feature that would not be available in a real application.
span.note: what this limits: the ablations using partial charge, which no deployment could reproduce: THIS FEATURE IS AN OUTPUT OF THE DFT CALCULATION AND THUS COULD NOT BE USED IN AN APPLIED SETTING
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Accuracy is measured against DFT approximations because experimentally true targets do not exist for the full dataset.
span.note: what this limits: every accuracy figure on this benchmark, which is agreement with a computation rather than with measurement: THE DATASET CONTAINING THE TRUE TARGETS ON ALL 134k MOLECULES DOES NOT CURRENTLY EXIST
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The paper's headline term is redefined to mean error against its own labels rather than against nature, and it says so in one sentence.
span.note: what this limits: the claim that this model reaches chemical accuracy: the authors state that in the rest of the paper the phrase means accuracy with respect to their available ground truth labels, not the community's target error relative to nature
